About 400 people came to the summit on Thursday, roughly double last year.

The talk people kept quoting the next morning was Dr. Osei's: she walked through three real incidents where a model quietly degraded in production, including one where the fix was a single mislabeled training file. Nobody filmed it, which she requested, so you had to be there.

The workshop rooms were too small. We planned for 30 per session and got 70; next year the workshops move to the main floor.
